title: Code of Hammurabi
description: Diorite stele inscribed with about 280 laws in Akkadian. Discovered at Susa in 1901-02 and now held in the Louvre.

title: Cyrus Cylinder
description: Clay cylinder in Akkadian cuneiform recording Cyrus the Great's capture of Babylon and his policies toward its temples.

title: Rosetta Stone
description: Granodiorite stele bearing a decree in hieroglyphic, Demotic and Greek; found in 1799 and key to deciphering hieroglyphs.

title: Res Gestae Divi Augusti
description: Augustus's own account of his achievements; it also reports the census counts of Roman citizens.

title: Han Dynasty census record (Book of Han)
description: The Hanshu records households and registered persons from the census of 2 CE, the earliest surviving large-scale census data.

title: Tabula Peutingeriana
description: Medieval copy of a schematic Roman road map showing the road network; held by the Austrian National Library.

title: Magna Carta
description: Charter of liberties agreed by King John at Runnymede in June 1215.

title: Travels of Marco Polo
description: Account of travels across Asia dictated in Genoese captivity and recorded by Rustichello da Pisa.

title: Catalan Atlas
description: Medieval world map attributed to Cresques Abraham; held by the Bibliotheque nationale de France.

title: Waldseemuller map
description: World map that first used the name America; held by the Library of Congress.

title: Peace of Westphalia treaties
description: Treaties of Munster and Osnabruck that ended the Thirty Years' War.

title: Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen
description: Foundational text of the French Revolution adopted by the National Constituent Assembly.

title: Golden Bull of 1356
description: Decree of Charles IV fixing the procedure for electing the King of the Romans by seven prince-electors, the framework behind the elections of 1400 and 1410-11.

title: Four Articles of Prague
description: Programme of the Hussite movement, set out in 1420 as the basis of its demands during the Hussite Wars.
